production.publisher_route: GitHub Actions publish.yml; conditional on IG_PUBLISH_ENABLED

reel.source_url_flag: The candidate source https://www.ibge.gov.br/indicadores/pnad is a PNAD indicator path and cannot by itself substantiate IPCA; verify official IPCA release

release_requirements: Confirm exact target Meta IG account with authenticated Graph API
Reconcile all 12 ledger records against live media IDs and ensure no duplicates
Verify approved closing logo, actual file hashes and carousel evidence
Verify official source and independent review of every queued item
Host and hash-check approved Reel and cover; verify Santa R 1.0, V5 and kinetic captions
Complete explicit pilot transition authorization only after reconciled closure
Merge reviewed changes and verify production checks; only then permit scheduling
watchdog: no duplicate task or watchdog created
learning: Passing CI does not establish external Meta account, file integrity, hosting or publication readiness. Preserve fail-closed behavior.
